facts.fact: 叙述者与 Galva 在 Oustrim 西陲山村用四枚 Molrovan 银币买下驴
村中正施公共刑罚：通奸女子上枷掷羊粪，背上写着 Othbleddr（Adulteress）
Galva 夜里也做噩梦，磨牙呻吟——她与许多 Daughters' War 参战者一样
facts.anchor: She was moaning in her sleep and grinding her teeth

facts.fact: 书从包里跑出摊开在地板上，用 Gunnish 写下并同步念出杀令：杀了偷书贼将获赏
facts.anchor: Enemies of the Guild are within this room. Kill them and return the book they have stolen

facts.fact: 墙上生出一张「kynd mouth」，书自报家门：十二部 Full Shadow 之一、Guild 珍宝
facts.anchor: I am one of only twelve Books of the Full Shadow, no two alike

facts.fact: 叙述者用骡包里的铁帐篷钉钉穿那张嘴；书咬住铁钉死于 magic-killing iron，血是墨水
facts.anchor: died around the magic-killing iron, bleeding ink

facts.fact: Galva 惊醒用 Ispanthian 质问「Če fus, jilnaedu?」
facts.anchor: What are you doing, vicious idiot?

facts.fact: 书页上的嘴插图回来了，墨色变浅，但现在它在微笑
